name: Rain-Listening Zither (Thính Vũ Cầm)

arts.name: Raindrop Pluck (Vũ Lạc Huyền)
arts.rule: One light note that strikes the foe's soul. Each soul hit you land adds a Toll (once a pulse), so it feeds the Tolling Bell Requiem from any hand.

lore: A short zither with a cracked soundboard, played by blind street-singers who listen to rain on roofs.
build_use: The Zither Player's first instrument: a cheap, quick soul note that also feeds Tolls to the Tolling Bell Requiem.

name: Quiet Mind Ring (Tĩnh Tâm Giới)
lore: A plain jade band that the novice monks of a meditation hall wear to still their thoughts.
build_use: Any soul build's early ring: more thần thức and soul damage, and a pool that refills between notes.

name: Muffled Temple Bell (Ám Chung)

wards.name: Muffled Bell Ward (Ám Chung Tráo)
wards.notes: The starter bell at 1.2 times its payload and its per-hit payment, so the price check is unchanged (3.019 of 3.050)

lore: A temple bell stuffed with felt so that it only hums; it was hung in the halls where soul-singers practised.
build_use: Anyone facing soul builds or slow heavy hitters: soul resistance on top of a bell ward.

name: Sandalwood Censer (Đàn Hương Lô)

reserve_arts.name: Incense Haze (Hương Yên Vụ)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your soul hits are 4 % stronger and your statuses on the foe last 8 % longer.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 10 % reserved buys up to 10 W (spends 8.8)

lore: A bronze bowl of sandalwood ash; the smoke seems to cling to whoever is thinking hardest.
build_use: The Incense Burner: Marked Prey rewards every different status laid on the foe, and the haze keeps statuses and soul hits stronger for a little linh lực.

name: Waking-Soul Jade (Tỉnh Hồn Bội)
lore: Pale jade that warms when its wearer is sung to; sect healers lend it to patients who cannot wake.
build_use: The Zither Player and anyone who plays Thorn Lullaby: more healing taken in, which the Lullaby's thorns turn into soul strikes.

name: Ledger Seal (Lục Ấn)

arts.name: Ledger Stamp (Lục Ấn Áp)
arts.rule: Counts as a Nine Seal Ledger art. A slow, heavy seal stamp that adds a Seal. With 2 Seals and either an Exposed foe, a Slackened Soul foe, or another ledger seal fired the same pulse, the stamp is entered in the ledger: 2.8 times as hard, it spends 2 Seals and exposes the foe.

lore: The magistrate's seal of a vanished dynasty's ledger-hall, where every debt of the dead was stamped.
build_use: The Ledger Keeper (Nine Seal Ledger builds): a fourth seal art the suite's Seal counter and Snare, Hour and Brand all count, and it gets the Slackened Soul the Bell canon lays.

name: Mourning Robe (Tang Y)

wards.name: Mourning Veil (Tang Sa)
wards.notes: The starter robe at 1.25 times its payload and its drain, so the price check is unchanged (3.788 of 3.813)

lore: White hemp worn by the singers who mourned for a living; it turns aside sound and the blows that carry it.
build_use: The Zither Player and Bell canon builds: Final Clause fires the longest-cooldown art free as you go Down, often a Death Knell, and the veil covers Force.

name: Echoing Ring (Hồi Âm Giới)
lore: A silver ring hollow as a flute; a note struck near it comes back a breath later.
build_use: Soul-note builds: Echo makes a quarter of every soul hit strike again, and each strike adds a Toll.

name: Thousand-String Zither (Thiên Huyền Cầm)

effects.name: Plucked Time (Huyền Trì)
effects.rule: When one of your song arts lands a soul hit, the enemy's next ready art is delayed by 0.4 s, at most once a second.
effects.reads: Your song arts landing soul hits, instant
effects.payload: Delay of the enemy's next ready art
effects.closes: Your arts that are neither soul nor song deal 15 % less.
effects.from: triple-metal-water-wood.md, The Zither Player (a soul art each second, each delaying the foe's next art; Soul Wound as an item Effect)
effects.status: in effects.md (approved by the user 2026-11-13; accepted 2026-11-12)

arts.name: Thousand-String Dirge (Thiên Huyền Điếu)
arts.rule: Counts as a Hollow Bell Canon art. A soul strike on the foe. Every song art you fire adds a Chord. With 3 Chords and either a Slackened Soul foe or another canon art fired the same pulse, the strings answer in chorus: a heavy extra soul strike that spends 3 Chords and adds 2 Tolls to the Bell. The next, with 6 Chords and either 2 Slackened Soul on the foe or you at 40 % health or less, spends 6 Chords for another and slackens the foe's soul.

holder: An elder of a Soul sect at Nascent Soul or above; otherwise Lost under the silted lake of a drowned music hall
lore: A zither of a thousand strings that was played by a court musician until the court listened to nothing else.
build_use: The Zither Player's keystone: every song art delays the foe, and the Dirge turns each fed chord into a Bell Peal's worth of soul strikes, at the price of weaker non-song arts.

name: Ninth Vigil Heart-Lamp (Cửu Canh Tâm Đăng)

effects.name: Lamp-Lit Reading (Đăng Chiếu)
effects.rule: Each different status of yours on the target lowers its soul resistance by 3 points, to at most 5 statuses.
effects.reads: Your different statuses on the target, live
effects.payload: Soul resistance reduction on the target
effects.closes: Your own soul resistance is 15 points lower.
effects.from: triple-metal-water-wood.md and triple-wood-fire-earth.md (the weakness 'soul resistance' of the Zither Player and the Incense Burner)
effects.status: in effects.md (approved by the user 2026-11-13; accepted 2026-11-12)

reserve_arts.name: Vigil Light (Thủ Canh Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, your soul resistance is 15 points higher and your thần thức 3 % higher.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 15 % reserved buys up to 15 W (spends 12.9)

holder: The abbot of a Soul sect's mountain temple; otherwise Lost in a collapsed meditation cave
lore: Nine monks kept this lamp alight through nine night-watches, and each one was found sitting before it, smiling.
build_use: Soul builds against high soul resistance (their stated weakness): Lamp-Lit Reading strips the foe's resistance for every status laid, and the vigil light covers the wearer's own.

name: Toll-Counting Needle (Điểm Chung Châm)

arts.name: Tolled Prick (Chung Điểm Thích)
arts.rule: A thin soul prick that adds a Toll on each soul hit (once a pulse). At 3 Tolls the needle rings the bell itself: a heavier extra soul strike that spends the 3 Tolls. It needs no Chord, only the Toll rhythm you already keep.

lore: A bone needle the bell-ringers of a hill temple used to count the strokes of the night watch.
build_use: Any soul build that keeps a Toll rhythm: a cheap soul weapon that turns every three Tolls into a heavier strike, with no Chord counter to feed.
notes: Answers: soul-lance: a soul weapon whose art fires on the build's own Toll rhythm without a chord counter. Spends about 21.6 of 25.6 W.

name: Seal-Bearer's Ring (Chấp Ấn Giới)
lore: A jade ring cut with a tiny seal-face; the clerks of a soul sect wore it to prove their stamp was true.
build_use: Seal builds and soul builds paid in thần thức: seal arts hit harder and come faster, and the divine sense rises.
notes: Answers: meta-hunter: a seal-scoped ring (seal attack and speed); soul-lance: a thần thức ring that raises the divine sense soul arts are paid in. Spends about 20.9 of 25.6 W.

name: Clear-Mind Robe (Thanh Minh Bào)

wards.name: Clear-Mind Ward (Thanh Minh Chú)
wards.payload: status +45 pp, cleanse 0.3 of every debuff batch per pulse
wards.notes: The starter ward at 1.2 times its payload, cleanse and reservation, so the price check is inherited (3.043 of 3.050)

lore: A plain grey robe the soul-song cloisters give novices whose minds were seized by a curse; it is said to wash a sealed mind clean.
build_use: Builds that fear curses and Stagnation: the ward cleanses debuffs every pulse and the robe resists soul and status.
notes: Answers: curse-engine: a cleanse answer to Sealed Meridian; meta-hunter: a cleanse piece for the Stagnation-immune concept. Spends about 22 of 25.6 W.

name: Hushed Vigil Cuirass (Tĩnh Canh Giáp)

wards.name: Hushed Vigil Ward (Tĩnh Canh Tráo)
wards.notes: The starter robe ward at 1.25 times its payload and its drain, typed Soul instead of Force, so the price check is inherited (3.788 of 3.813)

lore: Lacquered plates padded with felt, worn by the night-watchers of a soul sect so that no singer's voice could reach the mind beneath.
build_use: Builds facing soul-heavy foes: soul resistance on the plates, and a standing drain ward that soaks Soul damage from idle linh lực.
notes: Answers: soul-lance: a ward piece with soul_res_pct and a standing drain ward the combat sim can run. Spends about 20.6 of 25.6 W.
